name: shade
episode_count_meaning: Requested trial rows; see measured_episode_count for actual fresh generation episodes.

sampling.source: Polling parameter from nvml lane default; 10 ms polling does not imply a 10 ms sensor update rate.

workload.source: Operator-supplied workload-volume and wait/host allowances; these define the requested synthetic planning workload, not measured production token volumes. Override before spend approval.
workload.shape: 12 agent turns, 8 tool calls with 2 s wait each; cumulative uncached prefill 40000 tokens; 8000 generated tokens including reasoning.
